body:
I took one 750 mg pill of Robaxin. I had just been in a serious car accident and my friend got prescribed. She offered one to me about four hours after the accident.
I took the pill, smoked a small amount of weed, and then ate some food. I never felt any effects. About an hour after I took it my throat started to tighten up and I had mild difficulty breathing. I imagine that was from whiplash, but the Robaxin did nothing to alleviate that.
